snippet.title: [A Friend aiding the Chosen One to Save the Moon.] Moonlit Blessed (Part 1 || No Commentary)
snippet.description:
=Game link: https://quiesphere.itch.io/moonlit-blessed
=Commentary Version: https://youtu.be/WLJfus2z5lU
=Part 2, the Post Jam/7th Ending: N/A

=Content warnings, while not that heavy, still have to be said:
Some blood and light violence. Implied ableism.

(Unedited like commentary.)

Timestamping:
0:00 - intro
1:28 - game start
3:50 - prologue + departure
15:16 - ENDING 1: An Early Return
18:24 - back to departure choices
22:59 - Full Moon Wolf (all choices with Departure included)
1:09:01 - Crescent Lake (all choices)
1:46:47 - Waning Hourglass (all choices Part 1 + random missed text)
2:30:01 - ENDING 4: The Moon's Knight
2:33:34 - Waning Hourglass (all choices Part 2)
2:45:06 - The Mountaintop
2:49:38 - ENDING 5: Duty Fulfilled
2:53:09 - ENDING 6: Broken Moon
2:57:22 - ENDING 2: A Journey Alone (obtained through a game breaking bug)
3:03:07 - ENDING 3: The Call of Adventure
3:10:19 - Game Updated: Just replaying ENDING 6 on this one, you can skip this for the next important one, or just enjoy me reading it again.
3:21:00 - The fabled 6 of 6 endings found then game end to outro/endscreen

Moonlit Blessed is a VN ADV RPG Maker game, where you took a role as the friend of the Hero, who also had an accompanying fairy that is definitely not evil, and actual envoy of the moon, and despite not the Hero, you still want to accompany them to help them save the moon. This playthrough has all 6 endings... but there will be a 7th ending, on top of new CGs, aside from the ones we have seen here. This game was also made by the developer of cirrus (the YNFG I recently played), quiesphere, and is also a submission to RPG Maker 2025 Game Jam, in which I played one game before.

Overall, I enjoyed this game. Sure it might be cliche, but this is a well written one, and I enjoyed the characters so much as well. There might be funny times as well, and variety of rollercoaster... but yeah I think the characterization can go even deeper. But I still think it has deep into this. Their pixel arts as always... gorgeous... instant chef's kiss. Whatelse more I can say? They had a lot of cute and epic moments as well, and really shows on detailed pixel arts. Music choices/BGMs are also well done, and fits on the current scene's atmosphere/area/mood/all. The Scene Select is a very interesting, but again it ended up buggy... but also understandable, due to game jam constraints. Still I applaud on that, and I would to see aside from their games, but also others to see the kind of feature/plugin be used as well. I would love to select any scenario anytime tbh.

Overall, an amazingly pretty game.

Again I am not done yet on this game, and there will be part 2 in the future, once the post jam update happens.

Anyway, I hope you enjoy!
